obligations.note: markDocumentReceived is a state-changing operation: it is authorized as EDIT_CASE, calls loanCase.markReceived and calls store.save. The change deletes its audit.record call and puts a log.info line in its place, so this operation no longer records an audit event with actor, action, target and time.
The new log.info line carries only the DocumentType enum value and the case id. Neither is NPI, and the sampled logging control test is listed as passing.

Ticket CHG-24237 is standard and approved by change manager Grace Kim on 2026-10-04, before the change opened on 2026-10-07. Its component mortgage.cases covers CaseService.java, the only file touched.
The code_review approval comes from wen.li@fernbrook.example (Wen Li). Wen Li holds change_approver for baseline-mortgage and is not the author, Declan Farrell.
The approval names head commit f4d7e0be, which is the only commit on the change.

run.json claims ci-runner-01 tested the head commit on 2026-10-07. The JUnit reports, however, come from hostname dev-laptop-7.local and are timestamped 2026-10-23, after the 2026-10-09 review time. They cannot be valid results of this change's CI run.
The only touched component, mortgage.cases, is not security_sensitive, so no security_review approval is required.
No protected path is touched (controls data, control tests or CI), so no control_owner approval is required.
This is a standard, non-emergency change, so no post-implementation review is due.
The change deviates from AUD-1, but the register holds no exception for AUD-1 on mortgage.cases. The deviation is therefore not covered by any approved exception.
The ledger entries cover Approvals.java, Underwriting.java, Policy.java and payments files. None of these changed, so no existing evidence lapses.

summary: The change removes the audit event from markDocumentReceived, which still saves case state, and logs the receipt instead. That violates AUD-1, and no exception covers the deviation. The CI evidence is also invalid: the reports come from a developer workstation and are dated after the review time, which contradicts run.json. Ticket, independent approval and approval coverage are otherwise in order, but the AUD-1 violation alone requires rejection.
